title: Test 19 — Stage drift.
agent_prompt: Start acquiring images of the sample every 2 minutes. Adjust xy position, knowing the stage drift value. Stop acquiring images after 10 minutes. Display the images acquired in the napari GUI. Plot the xy position during the experiment to show, the corrected stage position. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
